documents.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Tools and Sample Syllabus Policy Statements
documents.summary: The Provost page recommends that every instructor put a generative-AI policy in the syllabus, encourages teaching ethical use over banning, and offers sample statements in three tiers: Restrictive, Supervised and Permissive. It also advises against using detectors as sole evidence and tells instructors not to paste student work into AI. Samples include UMKC Conservatory, English, and Computer Science statements plus Chicago, UT Austin and Harvard examples.
documents.stance_why: The page sets no single rule and hands the choice to instructors: "UMKC recommends that instructors include a policy in all their syllabi" and offers statements "arranged according to three degrees of AI use permissions: Restrictive, Supervised and Permissive". Because it offers tiers and templates, the stance is delegates.

notes: Single university-layer document. It hosts sample statements from other institutions (Chicago, UT Austin, Harvard) and from UMKC units (Conservatory, English, Computer Science); all were coded as units of this document, with fit_notes flagging the source. The UMKC CS statement is a computing-relevant sample but is not a standalone computing-unit document.
